Portfolio

Georgia Palmer is a model and entrepreneur making a name for herself as an alternative “it girl” of her generation. Part of Georgia’s appeal is that she is able to challenge conventional beauty standards, crafting and artful tension between feminine and masculine. She is a regular on the runway and in print, having walked for Alexander Wang, Balmain, and Natasha Zinko and appearing in British Vogue, Elle UK, and V Magazine, among others. She is featured in campaigns such as Adidas x Ivy Park, Burberry, Mugler, Swarovski, and 7 For All Mankind. She and her brother, model Joel Palmer, share the helm of a creative design studio, Sibling Studios, in east London.
